# TravelFlow: trip format for assistants

> TravelFlow is a visual travel planner. A trip is a timeline of stays, travel legs, activities and day trips, shown next to a map. Travellers plan multi-city trips, share them, and keep them in their account.

## How to hand over a trip

Assistants can plan a trip for a traveller and hand it to TravelFlow. TravelFlow checks the plan, stores it as a draft and returns a link. The traveller opens the link to see the trip on a timeline and map, then saves it to their TravelFlow account to edit, share or export it.

TravelFlow does not run any AI for this. Plan the full itinerary yourself, then send it. Please do not use TravelFlow's own trip generator (/create-trip) on a traveller's behalf.

Ways to hand over a trip, best first:
1. MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/mcp. Tools: get_trip_draft_schema, validate_trip_draft, create_trip_draft, get_trip_draft.
2. HTTP API: POST https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/trip-drafts with a JSON body. Dry run: POST https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/trip-drafts/validate. OpenAPI: https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/trip-drafts/openapi.json.
3. WebMCP: on any TravelFlow page, browsers with WebMCP expose get_trip_draft_schema, validate_trip_draft and create_trip_draft.
4. No tool access? Print the JSON in a code block and ask the traveller to paste it at https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/import-trip.

Format, rules and a complete example: https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/trip-drafts/schema (JSON) or https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/llms-full.txt (text).

## Request

The body is a JSON object. `trip` is the itinerary in TravelFlow's travelflow_trip_plan_v3 format. `startDate` (YYYY-MM-DD), `roundTrip` and `client` are optional.

Successful create response (HTTP 201):

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "draftId": "drf_…",
  "url": "https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/draft/drf_…",
  "expiresAt": "…",
  "title": "…",
  "startDate": "…"
}
```

Give `url` to the traveller. Unsaved drafts expire after 30 days. Errors come back as HTTP 422 with an `errors` list; fix each one and send again.

## Rules

- Send the itinerary as `trip` inside the request; every object must contain exactly the listed fields, no extras.
- cities[].days counts nights and must be a positive whole number. Total trip length = sum of days.
- travelSegments has exactly cities.length - 1 legs in order (cities.length legs when roundTrip is true). duration is in HOURS.
- activities[].cityIndex points into cities (0-based). dayOffsetInCity < that city's days, and dayOffsetInCity + duration <= days. duration is in DAYS (0.125, 0.25, 0.5).
- Descriptions are single lines: activities at most 90 characters, recommendation entries at most 80, headsUp at most 120.
- Use real coordinates (lat/lng) for every city and day trip, and uppercase ISO alpha-2 country codes.
- countryInfo describes the main country; all seven fields are required. exchangeRate is local units per 1 EUR.
- Call validate first if unsure: it returns a precise list of errors and stores nothing.
- The response contains a link. Give it to the traveller: they can view the plan right away and save it to their TravelFlow account to edit it.
- TravelFlow does not generate trips for you here; plan the trip yourself, then send it.
- Limits: at most 40 stops, 300 activities, 60 day trips and 256 KB per request.

## Complete example

```json
{
  "startDate": "2027-05-03",
  "roundTrip": false,
  "client": {
    "name": "example",
    "model": "none"
  },
  "trip": {
    "tripTitle": "Portugal: Lisbon to Porto",
    "countryInfo": {
      "currencyCode": "EUR",
      "currencyName": "Euro",
      "exchangeRate": 1,
      "languages": [
        "Portuguese"
      ],
      "electricSockets": "Type C, Type F",
      "visaInfoUrl": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Visa_policy_of_Portugal",
      "auswaertigesAmtUrl": "https://www.auswaertiges-amt.de/de/service/laender/portugal-node"
    },
    "cities": [
      {
        "name": "Lisbon",
        "days": 4,
        "recommendations": {
          "mustSee": [
            "Belém Tower",
            "Alfama",
            "Jerónimos Monastery"
          ],
          "mustTry": [
            "Pastel de nata",
            "Bifana",
            "Ginjinha"
          ],
          "mustDo": [
            "Ride tram 28",
            "Sunset at a miradouro",
            "Fado night"
          ],
          "headsUp": [
            "Steep, slippery cobblestones"
          ]
        },
        "countryCode": "PT",
        "lat": 38.7223,
        "lng": -9.1393
      },
      {
        "name": "Porto",
        "days": 3,
        "recommendations": {
          "mustSee": [
            "Ribeira",
            "Livraria Lello",
            "Dom Luís I Bridge"
          ],
          "mustTry": [
            "Francesinha",
            "Port wine",
            "Grilled sardines"
          ],
          "mustDo": [
            "Port cellar tour in Gaia",
            "Douro river cruise",
            "Walk the Ribeira at dusk"
          ],
          "headsUp": []
        },
        "countryCode": "PT",
        "lat": 41.1579,
        "lng": -8.6291
      }
    ],
    "travelSegments": [
      {
        "transportMode": "train",
        "duration": 3
      }
    ],
    "activities": [
      {
        "title": "Alfama walk",
        "cityIndex": 0,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 0,
        "duration": 0.25,
        "description": "Lanes, viewpoints and the castle above the old town.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "culture",
          "sightseeing"
        ]
      },
      {
        "title": "Belém",
        "cityIndex": 0,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 1,
        "duration": 0.5,
        "description": "Monastery, tower and the original pastéis de Belém.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "culture",
          "food"
        ]
      },
      {
        "title": "LX Factory",
        "cityIndex": 0,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 3,
        "duration": 0.25,
        "description": "Creative hub with shops, cafés and a huge bookshop.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "shopping"
        ]
      },
      {
        "title": "Gaia cellars",
        "cityIndex": 1,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 0,
        "duration": 0.25,
        "description": "Port tasting across the river from Ribeira.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "food",
          "culture"
        ]
      },
      {
        "title": "Douro cruise",
        "cityIndex": 1,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 1,
        "duration": 0.25,
        "description": "Six bridges cruise on the Douro.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "sightseeing"
        ]
      }
    ],
    "dayTrips": [
      {
        "title": "Sintra",
        "cityIndex": 0,
        "dayOffsetInCity": 2,
        "duration": 0.75,
        "destination": "Sintra",
        "lat": 38.7975,
        "lng": -9.3906,
        "description": "Pena Palace and Quinta da Regaleira in the hills.",
        "activityTypes": [
          "culture",
          "nature"
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Send it with curl:

```bash
curl -X POST https://travelflowapp.netlify.app/api/trip-drafts -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @trip.json
```

## JSON Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "TravelFlow trip draft request",
  "type": "object",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "trip": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "tripTitle": {
          "type": "string",
          "minLength": 1,
          "maxLength": 80,
          "description": "Short, human trip title, at most 80 characters, e.g. 'Portugal: Lisbon to Porto'."
        },
        "countryInfo": {
          "type": "object",
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "currencyCode": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "ISO 4217 code, e.g. 'EUR'."
            },
            "currencyName": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "e.g. 'Euro'."
            },
            "exchangeRate": {
              "type": "number",
              "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
              "description": "Local currency units for exactly 1 EUR, as a number (1 for the euro)."
            },
            "languages": {
              "type": "array",
              "minItems": 1,
              "items": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "description": "Main spoken languages."
            },
            "electricSockets": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "Socket types, e.g. 'Type C, Type F'."
            },
            "visaInfoUrl": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "A URL about visa rules (Wikipedia visa policy page or an official site)."
            },
            "auswaertigesAmtUrl": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "description": "The country page on auswaertiges-amt.de (German Foreign Office travel advice)."
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "currencyCode",
            "currencyName",
            "exchangeRate",
            "languages",
            "electricSockets",
            "visaInfoUrl",
            "auswaertigesAmtUrl"
          ],
          "description": "Practical facts for the main destination country. Every field is required."
        },
        "cities": {
          "type": "array",
          "minItems": 1,
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "description": "City or town name as a traveller would search it."
              },
              "days": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Nights spent at this stop, a positive whole number. The trip length is the sum of all nights."
              },
              "recommendations": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "properties": {
                  "mustSee": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 3,
                    "maxItems": 4,
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 80
                    }
                  },
                  "mustTry": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 3,
                    "maxItems": 4,
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 80
                    }
                  },
                  "mustDo": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "minItems": 3,
                    "maxItems": 4,
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 80
                    }
                  },
                  "headsUp": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "maxItems": 2,
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "minLength": 1,
                      "maxLength": 120
                    }
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "mustSee",
                  "mustTry",
                  "mustDo",
                  "headsUp"
                ],
                "description": "1-4 short strings each for mustSee, mustTry, mustDo (each at most 80 characters) and 0-2 headsUp warnings (each at most 120 characters)."
              },
              "countryCode": {
                "type": "string",
                "pattern": "^[A-Z]{2}$",
                "description": "ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in uppercase, e.g. 'PT'."
              },
              "lat": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -90,
                "maximum": 90,
                "description": "Latitude of the city centre."
              },
              "lng": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -180,
                "maximum": 180,
                "description": "Longitude of the city centre."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "name",
              "days",
              "recommendations",
              "countryCode",
              "lat",
              "lng"
            ]
          },
          "description": "Overnight stops in travel order. Do not repeat the first city at the end; set roundTrip instead."
        },
        "travelSegments": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "transportMode": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "plane",
                  "train",
                  "bus",
                  "boat",
                  "car",
                  "walk",
                  "bicycle",
                  "motorcycle"
                ],
                "description": "One of: plane, train, bus, boat, car, walk, bicycle, motorcycle."
              },
              "duration": {
                "type": "number",
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "description": "Door-to-door travel time in HOURS, e.g. 2.5."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "transportMode",
              "duration"
            ]
          },
          "description": "Exactly one leg between each pair of consecutive cities (cities.length - 1 legs; cities.length legs when roundTrip is true, the last one returning to the first city)."
        },
        "activities": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "title": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "cityIndex": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "0-based index into cities."
              },
              "dayOffsetInCity": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Day within that stop, starting at 0. Must be less than the stop's days."
              },
              "duration": {
                "type": "number",
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "description": "Length in DAYS: 0.125 (3 h), 0.25 (6 h) or 0.5 (half day). dayOffsetInCity + duration must not exceed the stop's days."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 90,
                "description": "One line, at most 90 characters."
              },
              "activityTypes": {
                "type": "array",
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 3,
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "general",
                    "food",
                    "culture",
                    "sightseeing",
                    "relaxation",
                    "nightlife",
                    "sports",
                    "hiking",
                    "wildlife",
                    "shopping",
                    "adventure",
                    "beach",
                    "nature"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "1-3 of: general, food, culture, sightseeing, relaxation, nightlife, sports, hiking, wildlife, shopping, adventure, beach, nature."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "title",
              "cityIndex",
              "dayOffsetInCity",
              "duration",
              "description",
              "activityTypes"
            ]
          },
          "description": "Things to do inside a stop. Optional but strongly recommended: 1-3 per full day."
        },
        "dayTrips": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "Same-day excursions from a stop that return in the evening. Use an empty array when there are none.",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "title": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "cityIndex": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Index of the base city the traveller leaves from and returns to the same day."
              },
              "dayOffsetInCity": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "Whole day within the base city's stay; must be less than the city's days."
              },
              "duration": {
                "type": "number",
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "description": "Length in DAYS, usually 0.5 or 0.75, never more than 1."
              },
              "destination": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "description": "Place visited, e.g. 'Sintra'."
              },
              "lat": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -90,
                "maximum": 90,
                "description": "Latitude of the destination."
              },
              "lng": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": -180,
                "maximum": 180,
                "description": "Longitude of the destination."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "minLength": 1,
                "maxLength": 90
              },
              "activityTypes": {
                "type": "array",
                "minItems": 1,
                "maxItems": 3,
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "general",
                    "food",
                    "culture",
                    "sightseeing",
                    "relaxation",
                    "nightlife",
                    "sports",
                    "hiking",
                    "wildlife",
                    "shopping",
                    "adventure",
                    "beach",
                    "nature"
                  ]
                }
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "title",
              "cityIndex",
              "dayOffsetInCity",
              "duration",
              "destination",
              "lat",
              "lng",
              "description",
              "activityTypes"
            ]
          }
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "tripTitle",
        "countryInfo",
        "cities",
        "travelSegments",
        "activities",
        "dayTrips"
      ],
      "description": "The itinerary, in TravelFlow's travelflow_trip_plan_v3 format."
    },
    "startDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days from today."
    },
    "roundTrip": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "True when the trip ends back in the first city. Do not repeat that city in cities; add the return leg to travelSegments."
    },
    "client": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "description": "Who is calling, for TravelFlow's statistics. Optional.",
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "maxLength": 80,
          "description": "Assistant or app name, e.g. 'chatgpt', 'claude'."
        },
        "model": {
          "type": "string",
          "maxLength": 80,
          "description": "Model name, if known."
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "trip"
  ]
}
```
